title: エイリアン
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one original square costume-selection sample for a character transformation web app.
Primary request: high-quality original adult ALIEN character transformation, with unmistakably extraterrestrial skin and ear anatomy connected to the same main person's readable face. One fully clothed adult, natural coherent body and joints.
Scene/backdrop: a simple bright science-fiction observation corridor, pale walls and an unobtrusive window with a soft distant blue planet, no other beings or foreground props.
Subject: one androgynous adult with short, natural dark brown hair, readable adult facial structure, expressive amber eyes and a calm expression. The whole face, neck and both hands have unmistakable opaque aquamarine-blue alien skin with subtle fine biological scale-like tessellation and softly contrasting darker teal cheek/temple patterns; it must not look like ordinary human skin with jewelry or painted glowing tattoos. The face remains a connected, identifiable adult humanoid face rather than a replacement mask or helmet. On each side of the head, ears are wide, rounded three-lobed fin membranes with clearly visible translucent cartilage ribs, attached anatomically beside the temples; these are NOT narrow pointed elf ears. Small organic ridges at the temples connect naturally to the fin ears; no horns or decorative headwear. Exactly two arms and two legs with consistently humanoid joints, natural hands and consistent five-finger structure.
Costume: a fully opaque structured dark navy expedition tunic with a high collar, simple violet-grey panel seams, full-length matching trousers and practical closed boots; fitted without exaggeration, complete coverage. Both hands are uncovered so the same alien skin is visible there. No armor, no robot parts, no weapons, no carried objects.
Style/medium: refined contemporary Japanese science-fiction anime illustration, clear original character design, precise linework, natural soft dimensional shading and high-quality believable fabric. A polished actual illustrative scene, not an icon or anatomy diagram.
Composition/framing: square full-body image; entire head with both broad fin ears, both arms and hands and both grounded boots visible; character occupies most of the frame, gentle relaxed standing posture with arms hanging naturally and empty hands. Face and ears remain large enough to recognize in a thumbnail.
Lighting/mood: soft clear daylight to distinguish opaque teal-blue skin and broad ribbed fin ears from the navy fabric; clean balanced contrast.
Text: none.
Constraints: one adult main character only; no additional person or animal; no elf appearance, pointed ears or human skin; no wings, horns, glowing lantern, jewelry clusters, magic book, forced action pose, franchise references, named artist, text, title, border, watermark or logo.
processing: Original generated PNG byte-for-byte copy; no resizing, cropping, retouching, or recompression.

observations: The face, exposed neck and both hands have continuous opaque cyan-blue alien skin with darker teal biological tessellation, rather than human skin with jewelry.
Broad ribbed fan-like fin ears attach to both sides of the same adult head and are visibly distinct from narrow pointed elf ears.
Short dark brown hair, adult facial outline and expressive amber eyes remain readable; no mask or replacement animal head.
One adult main character wears a fully opaque navy expedition tunic, full-length trousers and closed boots; there are no extra characters or separate creatures.
Both arms and empty hands, two legs and grounded boots are visible in a relaxed naturally supported standing pose, with no extra limb or carried prop.
visualQA.limits: Visual review of the complete original image; hand digit overlap may obscure individual fingers. No reference-person identity matching was requested for this sample.
